name: Glass add to cart
oneLiner: a product page on glass with a real product cut-out lit in its bay: a pointer presses Add to cart, a ripple runs through the button, the product lifts out and arcs into the cart icon, the cart bumps with a ring as its badge pops in, and the button floods green: Added
say: when the speaker says people buy it or add it to their cart ('they added it straight away', 'one tap and it is in the cart'): the press lands on 'add' or 'buy', the badge pops as the item lands in the cart; swap img for their own product cut-out
